Note: Each daily check-in period runs from 07:00 (UTC) each day to 06:59 (UTC) the following day. Check-in rewards are limited to the first 3,000 users who complete the check-in tasks. Only participants with level 3 KYC verification or higher completed before the event ends are eligible for rewards.

This event strictly adheres to compliance policies. Users from restricted countries and regions (whose account IP address or KYC verification belongs to such regions) will be ineligible to participate in this event.

3. Only spot trading volume with trading fees paid is counted towards this event. Trades with zero trading fees, negative fee rates, fee deduction coupons, or trial funds are not included in the volume calculation for the event.
4. Only trading fees actually paid are eligible for rebates. Trades with zero or negative fees, or trades made using fee deduction coupons or trial funds, are excluded.
5. All event rewards, including physical prizes, will be distributed in USDT of equivalent value. The actual amount credited to the winner's account shall prevail.

6. Reward distribution: All rewards will be distributed within 20 calendar days after the event ends. Once the rewards are distributed, log in to your account and go to Activity > Wallet to view your airdrop rewards. You can view your Spot Coupon in Reward Center > Coupon Center.

9. Participants found engaging in wash trading or using multiple accounts to win rewards repeatedly will be disqualified from this event.

(1) Inside information must be kept strictly confidential and must not be disclosed to any non-insider personnel (including family and relatives) inside or outside Poloniex.
(2) Insiders are not permitted to use their corporate or personal accounts to trade on Poloniex.

12. Poloniex reserves the right of the final interpretation of this event. If any user is found engaging in cheating, including farming rewards, wash trading, or exploiting platform vulnerabilities, the platform reserves the right to disqualify the user and reclaim any rewards issued.
